target_customer: Small merchants in Southeast Asia who sell through WhatsApp; today also clinics and other service businesses
problem: Small businesses already take orders by chat on WhatsApp but manage them by hand. Yezza gives them a storefront, orders and payments inside WhatsApp.
business_model: SaaS subscription of $12 per month plus up to $0.25 per order (per YC page); later add-on modules priced per month or per use
product_category: WhatsApp commerce storefront and small business operating software

founders.name: Ammar Roslizar
previous_startups: Tech-enabled travel company bootstrapped to $12M annual revenue selling packages on WhatsApp (name not given on the YC page)
founders.background_notes: Education and prior employers not found in an opened source.

founders.name: Wan Aizuddin
founders.background_notes: YC page bio says he loves coding; CTO and cofounder.

competitors.name: Wati
competitors.what: WhatsApp Business API team inbox and chat commerce tooling for SMBs

competitors.name: Interakt
competitors.what: WhatsApp commerce and customer engagement tool for small merchants

technical_complexity.rationale: A storefront, order and payment layer over the WhatsApp Business API, built and used for four years in the founders' own travel company before spin-out, per the YC page.

defensibility.rationale: Many chat commerce tools exist and WhatsApp itself is the platform. Merchant data and workflow give some lock-in, but copying the storefront is easy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found in sources. Yezza broadened into clinic and other vertical software.

market_need_then: YC page claims 50M WhatsApp Business downloads in Southeast Asia and buying via WhatsApp as normal behavior, with the founders' own travel business selling that way during COVID.

branding.domain_note: Operates on yezza.com (exact .com); acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Simple, direct, benefit focused, bilingual English and Malay (company site)

brand_strength.rationale: A brand search found no coverage of the name or its origin. The only evidence is the company site and YC profile.

pivots.from: Internal WhatsApp selling tool of a travel company
pivots.to: Standalone WhatsApp storefront product called Yezza
pivots.why: Offshoot during COVID per the YC page

outcome_analysis: Yezza claims to be profitable with $40K MRR and $3M monthly GMV at the time of the YC page, after spinning out of the founders' own WhatsApp travel sales business. It remains active and has broadened its site to clinic and other vertical software. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found. Funding is thinly documented.
notes: Seed amount conflicts across aggregators ($500K with Goodwater Capital and Olive Tree Capital, or about $125K to $130K) with no primary source, so no round is recorded. Competitor sources are undated profile pages, not dated to the batch. Founder education not found. Traction figures from the YC page and directories are company claims. Completeness pass: the $500K round rests on databases (Extruct dated 22 Mar 2022; CB Insights calls it a convertible note dated 29 Mar 2022); a YesPress timeline puts it near $125K to $130K. No press announcement found.
